messages:
maria: Quick heads-up from today's joint bench with Arco: new quant profile shows unexpected drop at seq=1024. Likely kernel tiling mismatch. Need a short sync on flags before marketplace image freeze.

ajay: can you share numbers and configs?

maria: baseline=1,020 tok/s, new-quant=835 tok/s (~18% drop). Redwood flags: L2_TILE=256, KV=combined. Arco flags: L2_TILE=512, KV=split + GEMM micro-patch.

lia-eng: doing quick A/B/C runs (Arco / Redwood / mixed) and capturing power/perf counters. pushing script to bench repo.

bench-bot: run created -> https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/6187656000-01 (A/B/C queued)

lia-eng: initial: A=820 tok/s, B=1005 tok/s, C=990 tok/s. Redwood defaults win for throughput; Arco patch reduces tail latency.

Tom-arco: we'll open a joint PR to align L2_TILE and include a cleaned GEMM patch (redacted) and mark partner-ready once CI passes.

maria: action items: PR (Tom), SI doc update (Ajay), 24h canary soak (Lia), embargoed one-pager for announcement (Maria). KPIs: tok/s delta <=5%, power delta <=3%, 95p latency within baseline. 48h checkpoint.

ajay: ack. I'll update SI checklist and add compatibility notes.

lia-eng: will queue soak once PR merges and post telemetry.

maria: marketing hold until eng sign-off. thanks all.
